name: Building Standards Law of Japan
references: Building Standards Law Enforcement Order, articles 23 to 25 (stairs, landings, handrails)
note: The row for buildings not otherwise listed; schools, theatres and large shops have stricter rows, a dwelling a looser one. A winder's going is measured 300 from its narrow end. The order gives no riser minimum, going maximum, step rule, headroom, riser count or uniformity: those are forgiving numbers.
